title: Atlantic article on Obama briefing, edited wording
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Atlantic article on Obama briefing, edited wording, about October 2010 at F.E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.
place_text: F.E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming

tellings.quote: October of 2010 the Atlantic wrote a pretty telling article it says and I quote President Obama was briefed this morning on a power failure at Fe Warren

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that in October 2010 the magazine The Atlantic wrote that President Obama had been briefed that morning on a power failure at F.E. Warren, an Air Force base in Wyoming. He quotes the article on an episode about UFOs seen near nuclear weapons bases, and suggests that its wording was later edited, which he finds telling.
